alerts.name: API unavailable
alerts.action: rollback or restore previous Render deploy

alerts.name: API not ready
alerts.action: inspect PostgreSQL, Redis and R2 readiness

alerts.name: High server errors
alerts.action: pause releases and inspect API logs

alerts.name: Slow API
alerts.action: inspect database, worker queue and resource use

alerts.name: Export backlog
alerts.action: inspect export worker and FFmpeg capacity

alerts.name: Release mismatch
alerts.action: stop cutover and reconcile deployed commit
